# Reuters reports on Burford's LegalTech Fund investment


- Law firm equity


November 17, 2025


-
-
-
-


Reuters reports on Burford's investment in The LegalTech Fund, a "venture capital firm that invests in early-stage legal technology startups." The Fund announced it had closed a second fund at $110 million.


Read the full article[here](https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactional/legal-tech-focused-venture-capital-firm-closes-110-million-fund-2025-11-17/) .
